# Iceberg Marketing Agency

> Depth Drives Growth. Uncovering the 90% hidden potential of brands across Egypt, the Middle East, and worldwide.

## Overview
Iceberg Marketing Agency is a premier digital marketing, custom web engineering, and brand acceleration agency based in Cairo, Egypt, serving regional and international clients across MENA, the GCC, North America, and Europe. We combine high-performance software engineering, search engine optimization (SEO), data-driven paid media buying (Meta, Google, TikTok), viral video and reel production, and brand architecture.

- **Website**: https://icebergma.com
- **Custom Domain**: https://icebergma.com
- **Contact Email**: hello@icebergma.com
- **HQ Location**: Cairo, Egypt (Serving MENA & Global)
- **Primary Languages**: English, Arabic

## Core Capabilities
- **Web Development & Engineering**: Fast, secure, custom web applications and conversion-optimized websites built on modern architectures. https://icebergma.com/parallax/services/web-dev.html
- **SEO & Search Visibility**: Technical SEO, local search dominance, semantic architecture, and content authority strategies. https://icebergma.com/parallax/services/seo.html
- **Performance Marketing & Paid Acquisition**: High-ROAS media buying campaigns across Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google Ads, and TikTok Ads. https://icebergma.com/parallax/services/performance.html
- **Social Media Management**: Community engagement, viral creative campaigns, and content calendars. https://icebergma.com/parallax/services/social-media.html
- **Brand Identity & Strategy**: Visual identities, brand positioning, logos, design systems, and guidelines. https://icebergma.com/parallax/services/branding.html
- **Videography & Reel Creation**: High-impact commercial video production, viral short-form reels, and motion design. https://icebergma.com/parallax/services/videography-reel-creation.html
- **IDEX Exhibition Lead Funnels**: Dedicated B2B lead capture, automated WhatsApp/CRM flows, and VIP booth pre-booking for medical and dental conferences. https://icebergma.com/idex
